articles.title: LATAM stablecoin liquidity may depend on few providers, investor says
articles.snippet: Researchers in a Latin American stablecoin ecosystem report warned “fragility in the system is concentrated in its thinnest layer,” with just 16 of 494 companies focused primarily on wholesale liquidity, treasury and credit.

articles.title: US Senator Blumenthal Calls Tether's USDT a 'Superhighway' for Iranian Sanctions Evasion
articles.snippet: The Connecticut Senator's subcommittee released its report on Monday and referred the findings to Treasury and the Justice Department.

articles.title: Someone Finally Jailbroke the PS5—Just After Sony Said Players Don’t Own Their Games
articles.snippet: Linear Fox founder Nathan Fargo released a public jailbreak for the PS5, dubbed Relapse, while Sony argues in court that players don't own their digital games.
